verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The tiny red 'EVENT MANAGEMENT' sits alone in the top-left corner, far from the headline it introduces. The left half is a shrunken confetti field with no content, while the owls and the three-line headline are packed together on the right with almost no gap between the brown owl and the text. B's owls and headline are slightly larger, but its owl is even closer to 'KIDS BIRTHDAY STUDIO', so neither is meaningfully better.
